body:
Tested locally (rebased on top of `master` eee39f004b42a4948af90cdebedf65c34a4a4970), it works as expected.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1e9c5c03-217c-4de2-9df0-cf155954337b

Note that this PR doesn't make it possible to opt out of this change. While using UIDs by default makes sense to encourage their use, we may want to allow holding <kbd>Ctrl + Shift</kbd> use a file path instead of UID in cases where it makes more sense to use file paths.

PS: This isn't specific to this PR, but I noticed drag-and-dropping can result in reserved names being used. For instance, if I drag-and-drop `node.gd`:

```
const Node = preload("uid://chqhud5j6k4s3")
```

I suppose this could be avoided by automatically adding a `Script` suffix to the dropped name when there's a conflict with a native class, i.e. `NodeScript` in this example.

> Note that Scripts can't be preloaded by UID, so putting as draft for now.

This is fixed in `master` (it also works for `load()`).

> Also, not directly related, but we may want to improve the presentation of UIDs in the script editor. Right now you can Ctrl+Click them to jump to the file, but that's about all. UIDs aren't very readable.

This was implemented in `master` by https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/100803.
